svg.title: Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ — blue
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. Portrait, 10 units/mm. Body 194.7 × 300.6 mm; centered display derived from 332.8 mm full-rectangle diagonal and 1800 × 2880 pixels. Original illustration: placement, corner radii, camera details and finish swatches are approximations. Sources: https://news.samsung.com/global/galaxy-tab-s10-fe-series-brings-intelligent-experiences-to-the-forefront-with-premium-versatile-design; https://www.samsung.com/us/support/answer/ANS10005059/; https://www.samsung.com/uk/tablets/galaxy-tab-s/galaxy-tab-s10-fe-plus-silver-256gb-wi-fi-sm-x620nzspeub/
